Direction change (owner, 2026-11-18): no shooting at exit or during play. Play only RECORDS moment state; a DARKROOM develops it later, when the title screen has been idle about 30 s (any key cancels). It uses a temporary copy of the SP world, actors rebuilt client-side, an Iris photo profile, and FA wrapped by Memento (FA overwrites vanilla mob textures: eyes moved to separate cubes, so "enable FA but hide its models" draws eyeless mobs). Gallery is 3–5 (default 5); exit shoot off by default (test tool only). Milestones: M1 motion playback (DONE in harness, branch time-sweep-spike, uncommitted), M2 moment record, M3 darkroom, M4 FA wrapper, M5 selection. Spec section "Revision 2026-11-18"; plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-18-memento-m1-motion-playback.md.
M1 gotchas: STB jpg writer calls back once PER BYTE (316k calls/frame). Buffer in native memory: 30 ms/frame, versus 450 ms with a channel write per callback. Util.ioPool is flooded during world close (10+ s delay), so Memento has its own writer. The still must be the sweep's center frame or the title jumps. NativeImage.read is PNG-only. TextureSetup has a 3-texture ctor; BindGroupLayouts.SAMPLER0_SAMPLER1_SAMPLER2 exists. Fade + blend share vertex z as alphaQ + 0.25 + blend/2, with a flat varying.
